query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bonded_warehouses (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  license_no VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  operator_id INT,
  operator_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  country VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NGA',
  address TEXT NOT NULL,
  port_code VARCHAR(10),
  capacity_cbm INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  used_cbm INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  bond_amount_usd BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  bond_expiry DATETIME,
  status ENUM('active','suspended','revoked','pending_renewal') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  approved_at DATETIME,
  approved_by INT,
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  INDEX idx_bw_operator (operator_id),
  INDEX idx_bw_status (status),
  INDEX idx_bw_port (port_code)
)
